properties.description:
The degree-zero rule inside `orphan_node` ran on `Decision` alone (heal.rs:879) and now runs on every node type nothing else asks about. That narrowness is why the pass whose job is structural soundness returned a false green: dev_storyflow's fleet got `clean` back over a DesignEpoch carrying NO EDGES AT ALL, in two packages, through every health call of a session.

MEASURED ON REFLOW2'S OWN GRAPH, 2026-08-16: 75 of 2406 nodes are degree-zero. The old rule reported 7 of them; the new rule reports 21. The 14 newly visible are 3 DesignEpochs marking nothing, 3 Fragments with no source, `ver:the-export-survives-being-read-back` — a check counted among the 159 passing that says what it checks to nobody — and 7 TemporalFacts whose `subject_id` names a node THAT DOES NOT EXIST, including `prj:reflow2` (the Project is `proj:reflow2`) and `cap:thin-install` (the node is `req:thin-install`).

THREE BOUNDS, and two of them exist because the first cut was wrong:

(1) NOT EVERY ATTACHMENT IS AN EDGE. `TemporalFact.subject_id`, `Snapshot.target_id` and `Question.gap_id` are required indexed PROPERTIES: those nodes name what they are about without ever drawing a link. The naive rule would have reported 48 of reflow2's own 212 TemporalFacts — 48 false findings shipped inside the change whose subject is instruments that overstate. A degree-zero node is now skipped when any property resolves to a live node id, which keeps the case that IS wrong: a pointer to a node the design no longer has. The unit test caught this, because `subject_id` is required and the fixture could not be built without one.

(2) BL-42 STAYS CLOSED. Requirement, Capability and Interface are excluded — DETECT asks about those by name (`unsatisfied_requirement`, `unallocated_capability`, `unprovided_interface`), and reporting them here as well is the same finding in two vocabularies that became 20 of 31 defects on the storyflow trial.

(3) A RESTING STATE IS NOT A DEFECT. Project and DesignRule are excluded. A Project alone means the design is EMPTY — what genesis produces on day one — and the phase rollups already say so. An advisory DesignRule can bind the PROCESS rather than a node, and demanding an edge would push authors to draw a relationship nobody meant. Widening a sweep without asking that question is how the correct action starts degrading the instrument (`req:a-deliberate-state-is-not-a-defect`).

Three fixtures were genuinely incomplete and were fixed rather than silenced: a "v1 baseline" epoch that was the baseline of nothing, a "v1.0" release that shipped nothing, and a recency test whose Verification verified nothing.
properties.name: A node attached to nothing is reported whatever its type, and a property that names a live node counts as attachment
